caseName: Los Angeles & Salt Lake Railroad v. City of Los Angeles
caseNameFull: Los Angeles & Salt Lake Railroad Company v. City of Los Angeles

opinions.text: October 11.1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of the State of California denied. Mr. A. S. Halsted, Mr. Oscar Lawler, Mr. Alex. Britton and Mr. Evans Browne for petitioner. No appearance for respondent.
